title: Annotated intraoral image dataset for dental caries detection
class_taxonomy: Binary primary (d) / permanent (D) tooth decay labels; WHO-aligned; not explicit ICDAS
notes: 5 standard views, W/R and W/O-R subfolders. Primary flagship caries intraoral dataset. Mixed + permanent dentitions. Pilot 505 (no retractor) + main 5808 images. Benchmarked YOLOv5s/v8s/v11, SSD-MobileNetv2, Faster R-CNN (best mAP=0.84). Kappa=0.89.

title: Caries-Spectra: A dataset of Enamel Caries
notes: 2000 low-res 224x224 JPG intraoral images: 800 advanced + 800 early-stage + 400 no caries. Classification only (no bbox/mask). Collected by American International University Bangladesh + Bangladesh University of Business and Technology. Permissive license.

title: AlphaDent: A dataset for automated tooth pathology detection
class_taxonomy: 9-class instance segmentation; caries assessed per 6 WHO-aligned classes (5 standard + WHO immune-zone class)
notes: 1200+ DSLR photos (Canon 6D mark II + 100mm macro + intraoral mirror) from 295 patients, Jan 2024-Jan 2025. Instance segmentation. Caries is one of 9 classes, annotated with WHO 6-class caries scheme. Training/inference code and weights also open. Dataset URL to verify in paper/GitHub.
